subject.title: feat(android): platform trust for public gateway certs + manual fingerprint pinning

question: Should Android adopt platform trust for eligible public DNS Gateway hosts while retaining explicit pins until a user selects the new system-trust action?
rationale: This is a deliberate change to the TLS trust model and stored-pin upgrade behavior; code review can assess correctness, but maintainers must confirm the intended security and compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after proof and parser repair
options.body: Keep the proposed policy, fix the OpenSSL input format, and require redacted upgrade and recovery evidence before merge.

options.title: Keep pinning as the default
options.body: Reject automatic platform trust and retain the existing pin-first behavior for all Android Gateway endpoints.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof and parser repair
